changes.old: Selected apps will route directly via your local network interface instead of WireGuard encryption.
changes.new: Selected Apps Will Route Directly Via Your Local Network Interface Instead Of WireGuard Encryption.

changes.old: Nsec VPN does not store browsing activity, DNS queries, traffic content, or originating client IP addresses in its app, backend, or agent.
changes.new: Nsec VPN Does Not Store Browsing Activity, DNS Queries, Traffic Content, Or Originating Client IP Addresses In Its App, Backend, Or Agent.

changes.old: We do not persist originating client IP addresses, DNS queries, browsing history, or traffic contents. WireGuard keeps current handshake and transfer statistics in kernel memory. Device registration and expiring peer configuration are persisted to authenticate access and restore peers after reboot; these are service records, not browsing logs.
changes.new: We Do Not Persist Originating Client IP Addresses, DNS Queries, Browsing History, Or Traffic Contents. WireGuard Keeps Current Handshake And Transfer Statistics In Kernel Memory. Device Registration And Expiring Peer Configuration Are Persisted To Authenticate Access And Restore Peers After Reboot; These Are Service Records, Not Browsing Logs.

changes.old: Your Curve25519 private key is generated locally inside your device's secure environment. Only your public key is sent to the server for tunnel handshake configuration.
changes.new: Your Curve25519 Private Key Is Generated Locally Inside Your Device's Secure Environment. Only Your Public Key Is Sent To The Server For Tunnel Handshake Configuration.

changes.old: You do not need an email address or password to use Nsec VPN. A randomly generated installation ID and a device-held registration secret authorize access. Android Keystore protects the local encryption key; hardware-backed storage depends on the device. Clearing local app data does not delete existing backend registration or billing records.
changes.new: You Do Not Need An Email Address Or Password To Use Nsec VPN. A Randomly Generated Installation ID And A Device-Held Registration Secret Authorize Access. Android Keystore Protects The Local Encryption Key; Hardware-Backed Storage Depends On The Device. Clearing Local App Data Does Not Delete Existing Backend Registration Or Billing Records.
